description: Shrink a PDF's file size by re-rendering its pages as compressed images. Choose Low, Medium or High quality and compare sizes before downloading.

faqs.a: Each page is rendered to an image and saved as a JPEG at your chosen quality. Lower quality means a smaller file; higher quality keeps more detail.
Yes — output pages are images, so text can no longer be selected or searched. It works best on image-heavy PDFs such as scans and photo documents.
faqs.q: Will text still be selectable in the compressed PDF?

faqs.a: Nothing is uploaded. The whole process — rendering, compressing and rebuilding — runs in your browser.
faqs.q: Is my file sent to a server?

howto: Choose a PDF file to compress.
Pick a quality level: Low (smallest file), Medium, or High (best detail).
Click "Compress PDF" and wait for the progress bar to finish.
Compare the original and compressed sizes, then download the result.
title: PDF Compressor
